page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Below the text: signature "Dd 3" at the foot, catchword "irre-" at the right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: qvar ;hæc accusatio duplici sensu intel-ligi potest, qvorum prior Catholicus est ab omnibus Catholicis probatus & usur-patus nedum à Capello : Posterior audax, temerarius,pœnaCanonica dignus,in qvẽ [?] non animadverti Capellum incidisse ; i-mo animadverti audaciam istam exhor-rentes eum ideo laudasse : Prior igitur accusationis sensus est,nemini licere post Concilii Tridentini decretum saltem post Clementis VIII. correctionem scri-benti commentaria in sacrum Tex-tum,aut qvovis aliomodo de re Theolo-gica tractanti asserrere,in vulgata editio-ne in esse aliqvem librarii errorem aut varias lectiones ex antiqvis Manuscriptis colligere,aut tueri lectionem aliqvam an-tiqvam esse significantiorem ea, qvæ re-tinetur in vulgata, aut comparare textus Hebræum,Chaldaicū,Translationes Græ-cas cum textu vulgatæ, licet sint plane diversi aut etiam contrarii , & horum textuum aliqvem videri hoc loco com-modiorem textu vulgatæ ; deniqve nun-qvam licere dictionem aliqvam vulgatæ,

page.notes: The word "qvẽ" at the end of line 5 has a superscript mark that is hard to read; it is marked [?]. The printed "post" in line 9 is kept as printed with a plain s. The spacing in "pœnaCanonica" and "Translationes Græcas" follows the print. The catchword "irre-" is the first word of the next page.
